conflicts.remarks_quote: This method returns True if the curve is an intersection curve, ellipse, trimming curve, or a surface parametric curve. Because intersection and trimming curves can be lines or circles, it is advisable to first determine whether the curve is a circle or line before recognizing it as a b-curve.
conflicts.why: Remarks 说 ellipse 也返回 True、True 不等于 b-curve 且须先排除圆与直线；示例却对椭圆边断言 IsBcurve 并直接当 b-curve 取参数。
